experiment: On-device real-TFLite phase-split latency — Raspberry Pi 5 (aarch64 A76), CONFIRMED
model: models/classifier_float32.tflite (real production TFLite FFI classifier, d=42)
pipeline: real 3-thread pipeline (sensor -> defense -> rotation) driven by phase_latency bin with EDGE_MODEL_PATH set to the real classifier; PhaseMixSensor alternates benign/adversarial segments
interpretation: p50/p95/p99 all 0.0014 ms on the Pi A76 — even tighter than x86 dev (p50 0.0020 ms), consistent with the documented p50/p99 behavior (median governed by the FP Givens-rotation/manifold path on the A76 vs entropy on x86 tail). Both platforms far inside the 50 ms Edge SLA; SLA is non-binding. Confirms the aarch64 real-classifier number that #6's MockModel prototype could not supply.
